scriptName: WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4
source:
//@version=6
strategy("WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4", overlay=true, pyramiding=0, process_orders_on_close=true, calc_on_order_fills=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

//==================================================
// INPUTS
//==================================================

groupTrend = "1. Trend"
fastLen = input.int(20, "Fast EMA", minval=1, group=groupTrend)
slowLen = input.int(50, "Slow EMA", minval=1, group=groupTrend)
adxLen = input.int(14, "ADX Length", minval=1, group=groupTrend)
minAdx = input.float(18.0, "Minimum ADX", step=0.5, group=groupTrend)

groupBreakout = "2. Breakout"
pivotLen = input.int(3, "Swing Pivot Length", minval=1, group=groupBreakout)
maxLevelAge = input.int(80, "Maximum Swing Age", minval=5, group=groupBreakout)
prepDistPct = input.float(0.25, "Prep Distance %", minval=0.01, step=0.01, group=groupBreakout)

groupQuality = "3. Signal Quality"
atrLen = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=1, group=groupQuality)
minAtrPct = input.float(0.20, "Minimum ATR %", minval=0.01, step=0.01, group=groupQuality)
volumeLen = input.int(20, "Volume Average Length", minval=1, group=groupQuality)
minVolumeFactor = input.float(1.10, "Minimum Volume Factor", minval=0.10, step=0.05, group=groupQuality)
minBodyRatio = input.float(0.55, "Minimum Candle Body Ratio", minval=0.10, maxval=1.00, step=0.01, group=groupQuality)
maxOppositeWick = input.float(0.30, "Maximum Opposite Wick Ratio", minval=0.00, maxval=1.00, step=0.01, group=groupQuality)

groupFlow = "4. Money Flow"
useFlowFilter = input.bool(true, "Use Money Flow Filter", group=groupFlow)
mfiLen = input.int(14, "MFI Length", minval=1, group=groupFlow)
longMinMfi = input.float(50.0, "Long Minimum MFI", minval=0, maxval=100, step=0.5, group=groupFlow)
shortMaxMfi = input.float(50.0, "Short Maximum MFI", minval=0, maxval=100, step=0.5, group=groupFlow)
flowLen = input.int(20, "Volume Flow Length", minval=1, group=groupFlow)

groupZones = "5. Supply / Demand Zones"
zonePivotLen = input.int(5, "Zone Pivot Length", minval=1, group=groupZones)
zoneMaxAge = input.int(250, "Maximum Zone Age", minval=10, group=groupZones)
zoneVolumeFactor = input.float(1.20, "Zone Volume Factor", minval=0.10, step=0.05, group=groupZones)
orderBlockLookback = input.int(20, "Order Block Lookback", minval=2, maxval=100, group=groupZones)
minimumRoomPct = input.float(0.40, "Minimum Room To Target %", minval=0.05, step=0.05, group=groupZones)
zoneBufferPct = input.float(0.12, "SL / TP Buffer %", minval=0.00, step=0.01, group=groupZones)

groupRisk = "6. Fallback Risk"
useFallback = input.bool(true, "Use ATR Fallback When No Zone Exists", group=groupRisk)
fallbackAtrMult = input.float(1.00, "Fallback ATR Stop", minval=0.10, step=0.10, group=groupRisk)
fallbackRR = input.float(1.00, "Fallback Risk / Reward", minval=0.10, step=0.10, group=groupRisk)

groupDisplay = "7. Display"
showEMAs = input.bool(true, "Show EMAs", group=groupDisplay)
showSwingLevels = input.bool(true, "Show Swing Levels", group=groupDisplay)
showZones = input.bool(true, "Show Supply / Demand Zones", group=groupDisplay)
showPrep = input.bool(true, "Show Prep Signals", group=groupDisplay)
showTradeLevels = input.bool(true, "Show Entry / SL / TP", group=groupDisplay)
showScoreLabels = input.bool(true, "Show Score Labels", group=groupDisplay)

//==================================================
// TREND
//==================================================

emaFast = ta.ema(close, fastLen)
emaSlow = ta.ema(close, slowLen)

trendLong = emaFast > emaSlow and emaSlow > emaSlow[1]
trendShort = emaFast < emaSlow and emaSlow < emaSlow[1]

//==================================================
// ATR
//==================================================

atrValue = ta.atr(atrLen)
atrPercent = close != 0 ? atrValue / close * 100.0 : 0.0
atrOk = atrPercent >= minAtrPct

//==================================================
// ADX
//==================================================

upMove = high - high[1]
downMove = low[1] - low

plusDM = upMove > downMove and upMove > 0 ? upMove : 0.0
minusDM = downMove > upMove and downMove > 0 ? downMove : 0.0

trueRangeRma = ta.rma(ta.tr, adxLen)
plusDI = trueRangeRma != 0 ? 100.0 * ta.rma(plusDM, adxLen) / trueRangeRma : 0.0
minusDI = trueRangeRma != 0 ? 100.0 * ta.rma(minusDM, adxLen) / trueRangeRma : 0.0

diSum = plusDI + minusDI
dx = diSum != 0 ? 100.0 * math.abs(plusDI - minusDI) / diSum : 0.0
adxValue = ta.rma(dx, adxLen)
adxOk = adxValue >= minAdx

//==================================================
// VOLUME
//==================================================

volumeAverage = ta.sma(volume, volumeLen)
volumeOk = not na(volumeAverage) and volume > volumeAverage * minVolumeFactor

//==================================================
// CANDLE QUALITY
//==================================================

candleRange = math.max(high - low, syminfo.mintick)
candleBody = math.abs(close - open)
bodyRatio = candleBody / candleRange

upperWick = high - math.max(open, close)
lowerWick = math.min(open, close) - low

upperWickRatio = upperWick / candleRange
lowerWickRatio = lowerWick / candleRange

longCandleOk = close > open and bodyRatio >= minBodyRatio and upperWickRatio <= maxOppositeWick
shortCandleOk = close < open and bodyRatio >= minBodyRatio and lowerWickRatio <= maxOppositeWick

//==================================================
// SWING LEVELS
//==================================================

swingHighPivot = ta.pivothigh(high, pivotLen, pivotLen)
swingLowPivot = ta.pivotlow(low, pivotLen, pivotLen)

var float lastSwingHigh = na
var float lastSwingLow = na
var int lastSwingHighBar = na
var int lastSwingLowBar = na

if not na(swingHighPivot)
    lastSwingHigh := swingHighPivot
    lastSwingHighBar := bar_index - pivotLen

if not na(swingLowPivot)
    lastSwingLow := swingLowPivot
    lastSwingLowBar := bar_index - pivotLen

validSwingHigh = not na(lastSwingHigh) and not na(lastSwingHighBar) and bar_index - lastSwingHighBar <= maxLevelAge
validSwingLow = not na(lastSwingLow) and not na(lastSwingLowBar) and bar_index - lastSwingLowBar <= maxLevelAge

longBreakoutLevel = validSwingHigh ? lastSwingHigh : na
shortBreakoutLevel = validSwingLow ? lastSwingLow : na

//==================================================
// PREPARATION SIGNALS
//==================================================

longPrepDistance = validSwingHigh and close < longBreakoutLevel ? (longBreakoutLevel - close) / close * 100.0 : na
shortPrepDistance = validSwingLow and close > shortBreakoutLevel ? (close - shortBreakoutLevel) / close * 100.0 : na

nearLongPrep = validSwingHigh and trendLong and not na(longPrepDistance) and longPrepDistance <= prepDistPct
nearShortPrep = validSwingLow and trendShort and not na(shortPrepDistance) and shortPrepDistance <= prepDistPct

//==================================================
// ORIGINAL 6 / 6 SCORE
//==================================================

longScore = (trendLong ? 1 : 0) + (adxOk ? 1 : 0) + (atrOk ? 1 : 0) + (volumeOk ? 1 : 0) + (longCandleOk ? 1 : 0) + (validSwingHigh ? 1 : 0)
shortScore = (trendShort ? 1 : 0) + (adxOk ? 1 : 0) + (atrOk ? 1 : 0) + (volumeOk ? 1 : 0) + (shortCandleOk ? 1 : 0) + (validSwingLow ? 1 : 0)

//==================================================
// MONEY FLOW
//==================================================

mfiValue = ta.mfi(hlc3, mfiLen)

signedVolume = close > open ? volume : close < open ? -volume : 0.0
volumeFlow = ta.ema(signedVolume, flowLen)

longFlowOk = not useFlowFilter or (mfiValue >= longMinMfi and volumeFlow > 0)
shortFlowOk = not useFlowFilter or (mfiValue <= shortMaxMfi and volumeFlow < 0)

//==================================================
// SUPPLY / DEMAND ZONES
//==================================================

zoneHighPivot = ta.pivothigh(high, zonePivotLen, zonePivotLen)
zoneLowPivot = ta.pivotlow(low, zonePivotLen, zonePivotLen)
zoneVolumeAverage = ta.sma(volume, volumeLen)

var float supplyTop = na
var float supplyBottom = na
var int supplyCreatedBar = na

var float demandTop = na
var float demandBottom = na
var int demandCreatedBar = na

pivotVolumeAverage = zoneVolumeAverage[zonePivotLen]
pivotVolumeOk = not na(pivotVolumeAverage) and volume[zonePivotLen] >= pivotVolumeAverage * zoneVolumeFactor

if not na(zoneHighPivot) and pivotVolumeOk
    supplyTop := high[zonePivotLen]
    supplyBottom := math.max(open[zonePivotLen], close[zonePivotLen])
    supplyCreatedBar := bar_index - zonePivotLen

if not na(zoneLowPivot) and pivotVolumeOk
    demandBottom := low[zonePivotLen]
    demandTop := math.min(open[zonePivotLen], close[zonePivotLen])
    demandCreatedBar := bar_index - zonePivotLen

validSupply = not na(supplyTop) and not na(supplyBottom) and not na(supplyCreatedBar) and bar_index - supplyCreatedBar <= zoneMaxAge
validDemand = not na(demandTop) and not na(demandBottom) and not na(demandCreatedBar) and bar_index - demandCreatedBar <= zoneMaxAge

if validSupply and close > supplyTop
    supplyTop := na
    supplyBottom := na
    supplyCreatedBar := na

if validDemand and close < demandBottom
    demandTop := na
    demandBottom := na
    demandCreatedBar := na

validSupply := not na(supplyTop) and not na(supplyBottom) and not na(supplyCreatedBar) and bar_index - supplyCreatedBar <= zoneMaxAge
validDemand := not na(demandTop) and not na(demandBottom) and not na(demandCreatedBar) and bar_index - demandCreatedBar <= zoneMaxAge

//==================================================
// ORDER BLOCK FUNCTIONS
//==================================================

f_last_bearish_ob_bottom(_lookback) =>
    float result = na
    for i = 1 to _lookback
        if na(result) and close[i] < open[i]
            result := low[i]
    result

f_last_bullish_ob_top(_lookback) =>
    float result = na
    for i = 1 to _lookback
        if na(result) and close[i] > open[i]
            result := high[i]
    result

bullishOrderBlockBottom = f_last_bearish_ob_bottom(orderBlockLookback)
bearishOrderBlockTop = f_last_bullish_ob_top(orderBlockLookback)

//==================================================
// BREAKOUT CONDITIONS
//==================================================

longBreakout = validSwingHigh and close > longBreakoutLevel and close[1] <= longBreakoutLevel
shortBreakout = validSwingLow and close < shortBreakoutLevel and close[1] >= shortBreakoutLevel

rawLongSignal = longBreakout and longScore == 6 and longFlowOk
rawShortSignal = shortBreakout and shortScore == 6 and shortFlowOk

//==================================================
// TRADE VARIABLES
//==================================================

var float tradeEntry = na
var float tradeStop = na
var float tradeTarget = na

var bool longEntrySignal = false
var bool shortEntrySignal = false

longEntrySignal := false
shortEntrySignal := false

positionFlat = strategy.position_size == 0
positionLong = strategy.position_size > 0
positionShort = strategy.position_size < 0

bufferMultiplier = zoneBufferPct / 100.0

//==================================================
// LONG TRADE
//==================================================

if rawLongSignal and positionFlat
    float longStopCandidate = na
    float longTargetCandidate = na

    if not na(bullishOrderBlockBottom) and bullishOrderBlockBottom < close
        longStopCandidate := bullishOrderBlockBottom

    if na(longStopCandidate) and validDemand and demandBottom < close
        longStopCandidate := demandBottom

    if validSupply and supplyBottom > close
        longTargetCandidate := supplyBottom

    bool longRoomOk = true

    if not na(longTargetCandidate)
        float longRoomPercent = (longTargetCandidate - close) / close * 100.0
        longRoomOk := longRoomPercent >= minimumRoomPct

    if longRoomOk
        tradeEntry := close

        if not na(longStopCandidate)
            tradeStop := longStopCandidate * (1.0 - bufferMultiplier)
        else
            tradeStop := useFallback ? close - atrValue * fallbackAtrMult : na

        float longRisk = not na(tradeStop) ? tradeEntry - tradeStop : na

        if not na(longTargetCandidate)
            tradeTarget := longTargetCandidate * (1.0 - bufferMultiplier)
        else
            tradeTarget := useFallback and not na(longRisk) ? tradeEntry + longRisk * fallbackRR : na

        bool validLongRisk = not na(tradeStop) and not na(tradeTarget) and tradeStop < tradeEntry and tradeTarget > tradeEntry

        if validLongRisk
            longEntrySignal := true
            strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, comment="LONG 6/6")
            strategy.exit("Long TP/SL", from_entry="Long", stop=tradeStop, limit=tradeTarget, comment_profit="TP", comment_loss="SL")
        else
            tradeEntry := na
            tradeStop := na
            tradeTarget := na

//==================================================
// SHORT TRADE
//==================================================

if rawShortSignal and positionFlat
    float shortStopCandidate = na
    float shortTargetCandidate = na

    if not na(bearishOrderBlockTop) and bearishOrderBlockTop > close
        shortStopCandidate := bearishOrderBlockTop

    if na(shortStopCandidate) and validSupply and supplyTop > close
        shortStopCandidate := supplyTop

    if validDemand and demandTop < close
        shortTargetCandidate := demandTop

    bool shortRoomOk = true

    if not na(shortTargetCandidate)
        float shortRoomPercent = (close - shortTargetCandidate) / close * 100.0
        shortRoomOk := shortRoomPercent >= minimumRoomPct

    if shortRoomOk
        tradeEntry := close

        if not na(shortStopCandidate)
            tradeStop := shortStopCandidate * (1.0 + bufferMultiplier)
        else
            tradeStop := useFallback ? close + atrValue * fallbackAtrMult : na

        float shortRisk = not na(tradeStop) ? tradeStop - tradeEntry : na

        if not na(shortTargetCandidate)
            tradeTarget := shortTargetCandidate * (1.0 + bufferMultiplier)
        else
            tradeTarget := useFallback and not na(shortRisk) ? tradeEntry - shortRisk * fallbackRR : na

        bool validShortRisk = not na(tradeStop) and not na(tradeTarget) and tradeStop > tradeEntry and tradeTarget < tradeEntry

        if validShortRisk
            shortEntrySignal := true
            strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short, comment="SHORT 6/6")
            strategy.exit("Short TP/SL", from_entry="Short", stop=tradeStop, limit=tradeTarget, comment_profit="TP", comment_loss="SL")
        else
            tradeEntry := na
            tradeStop := na
            tradeTarget := na

//==================================================
// MAINTAIN ACTIVE EXIT
//==================================================

if positionLong and not na(tradeStop) and not na(tradeTarget)
    strategy.exit("Long TP/SL", from_entry="Long", stop=tradeStop, limit=tradeTarget, comment_profit="TP", comment_loss="SL")

if positionShort and not na(tradeStop) and not na(tradeTarget)
    strategy.exit("Short TP/SL", from_entry="Short", stop=tradeStop, limit=tradeTarget, comment_profit="TP", comment_loss="SL")

//==================================================
// RESET AFTER TRADE CLOSE
//==================================================

tradeJustClosed = strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] != 0

if tradeJustClosed
    tradeEntry := na
    tradeStop := na
    tradeTarget := na

//==================================================
// SUPPLY / DEMAND VISUALS
//==================================================

supplyTopPlot = plot(showZones and validSupply ? supplyTop : na, title="Supply Top", color=color.new(color.red, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)
supplyBottomPlot = plot(showZones and validSupply ? supplyBottom : na, title="Supply Bottom", color=color.new(color.red, 70), style=plot.style_linebr)
fill(supplyTopPlot, supplyBottomPlot, color=color.new(color.red, 90), title="Supply Zone")

demandTopPlot = plot(showZones and validDemand ? demandTop : na, title="Demand Top", color=color.new(color.lime, 70), style=plot.style_linebr)
demandBottomPlot = plot(showZones and validDemand ? demandBottom : na, title="Demand Bottom", color=color.new(color.lime, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)
fill(demandTopPlot, demandBottomPlot, color=color.new(color.green, 90), title="Demand Zone")

//==================================================
// EMA VISUALS
//==================================================

plot(showEMAs ? emaFast : na, title="EMA Fast", color=color.new(color.green, 0), linewidth=2)
plot(showEMAs ? emaSlow : na, title="EMA Slow", color=color.new(color.orange, 0), linewidth=2)

//==================================================
// SWING LEVEL VISUALS
//==================================================

plot(showSwingLevels and validSwingHigh ? longBreakoutLevel : na, title="Swing High", color=color.new(color.aqua, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showSwingLevels and validSwingLow ? shortBreakoutLevel : na, title="Swing Low", color=color.new(color.fuchsia, 0), style=plot.style_linebr)

//==================================================
// ACTIVE TRADE LEVELS
//==================================================

activeTrade = strategy.position_size != 0 or longEntrySignal or shortEntrySignal

plot(showTradeLevels and activeTrade ? tradeEntry : na, title="Entry", color=color.new(color.white, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLevels and activeTrade ? tradeStop : na, title="Stop Loss", color=color.new(color.red, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLevels and activeTrade ? tradeTarget : na, title="Take Profit", color=color.new(color.lime, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)

//==================================================
// PREP SIGNALS
//==================================================

plotshape(showPrep and nearLongPrep and positionFlat, title="Long Prep", style=shape.circle, location=location.belowbar, size=size.tiny, color=color.new(color.lime, 0), text="PREP", textcolor=color.white)
plotshape(showPrep and nearShortPrep and positionFlat, title="Short Prep", style=shape.circle, location=location.abovebar, size=size.tiny, color=color.new(color.red, 0), text="PREP", textcolor=color.white)

//==================================================
// ENTRY SIGNALS
//==================================================

plotshape(longEntrySignal, title="Long Entry", style=shape.labelup, location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.green, 0), text="LONG 6/6", textcolor=color.white)
plotshape(shortEntrySignal, title="Short Entry", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red, 0), text="SHORT 6/6", textcolor=color.white)

//==================================================
// SCORE LABELS
//==================================================

if showScoreLabels and longEntrySignal
    label.new(bar_index, low, "6/6 + FLOW", style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.green, 60), textcolor=color.white)

if showScoreLabels and shortEntrySignal
    label.new(bar_index, high, "6/6 + FLOW", style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.red, 60), textcolor=color.white)

//==================================================
// ALERTS
//==================================================

alertcondition(nearLongPrep and positionFlat, title="Long Preparation", message="WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4: Long preparation")
alertcondition(nearShortPrep and positionFlat, title="Short Preparation", message="WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4: Short preparation")
alertcondition(longEntrySignal, title="Long Entry", message="WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4: LONG 6/6")
alertcondition(shortEntrySignal, title="Short Entry", message="WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4: SHORT 6/6")
